RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
any
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to delete users from the group.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot find the specified group or user.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management failed to remove the user from the group.
